events.speaker: caller
events.text: Hello, Microsoft-certified support. Your license expired and your PC will be shut down.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I don't have a license problem.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: I show that you do. We can renew it for 399.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: I just need you to let me into the computer with this little program called TeamViewer, and then we'll process the payment.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I'd rather go to a store.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: The shutdown is in one hour, you won't make it.
